scope: Read-only review of the frozen E3c-3a build, display path, and IDF SPI/LCD path.

device_log.sequence: A right-swipe is followed 41 ms later by a private SPI TX DMA-buffer allocation failure, then the color transaction queue reports failure.

source_chain.finding: CASET and RASET errors propagate, but the tx_color result is discarded and draw_bitmap returns ESP_OK.
Color is sent in bounded chunks; the completion callback is enabled only for the final chunk. A queue failure exits with an error before the failed chunk is queued.

Default LVGL flush signals ready on a reported draw error, otherwise relies on completion. Dummy blit also relies on the color-done event when wait=true. Because the panel driver masks color-send failure, both paths can wait without their expected completion.

finding.assessment: The device log and frozen sources show a direct, credible failure path matching the UI stall. This identifies a driver error-propagation defect; the log alone does not establish it as the only possible cause. No largest contiguous internal DMA-block metric was captured, so allocation failure cannot be attributed specifically to fragmentation or total free memory.

query_off_on.conclusion: These size deltas do not establish query logic as the cause. The config switch could affect runtime timing or heap use, but the available data does not measure that effect.

usb_path.coverage: Frozen and candidate USB task behavior with VFS and FreeRTOS stubs.

existing_host_tests.display_dma: No existing native SPI/LCD DMA failure harness was found.

recommended_offline_cases: Extract only the frozen ST77916 draw_bitmap, LVGL default flush, dummy blit, and IDF color-queue logic under test; compile them with Zig and narrow native stubs.
Verify successful draw, CASET failure, and RASET failure propagation.
Inject TX queue failure on first, middle, and final chunks; verify the error reaches callers and no wait depends on a missing completion callback.
Verify partially queued transactions are reclaimed, then run a successful next frame and confirm one completion/flush-ready notification.
